name: Silhouette editor as a document with its own event graph
body: Dean (2026-11-27): graphs and Silhouettes are the same thing, as a Blueprint is in Unreal: the graph belongs to the Silhouette. Double-clicking a Silhouette in the asset browser opens the Silhouette editor as a document: viewport in the centre, inspector on the right with every property, hierarchy on the left with child Silhouettes and game components, and a tab to switch to the graph, where pins come off events such as BeginPlay, Update and FixedUpdate. Plan and decisions: docs/silhouette-editor.md.

questions.text: How should existing standalone graphs move into Silhouettes? Recommended: behaviour graphs move into the Silhouette that uses them, pure function graphs stay as function libraries. Alternatives: every graph moves into a Silhouette, or keep both with no migration.
questions.answer: Dean (2026-11-27): behaviours move, functions stay. lamp_pulse moves into scripted_lamp; crumble_phase stays in game-graphs as a function library.
